units.source_text: 对于把这-一看在眼里的我来说，并不喜欢他那种谨小慎微，

en.t: As for me, watching all this, I disliked that kind of overcautious fussiness in him,

units.source_text: 譬如不是为了放火，而只是为了抽一支烟却如此胆怯地环顾四周。

en.t: for instance, the way he looked around so timidly, not because he meant to set a fire, but merely because he wanted to smoke a cigarette.

units.source_text: 也就是说，那种学生哥的逃避法规的小气的喜悦，

en.t: In other words, that petty studentish pleasure in evading the rules,

units.source_text: 那种小心地踩踏已经熄灭了的烟火的态度，实是过于谨慎了。

en.t: that attitude of carefully stamping on sparks that had already gone out, was really far too cautious.

units.source_text: 总之，他的"文化素质"，尤其是后面的玩意儿，我是很不欣赏的。

en.t: In short, I had very little admiration for his "cultural refinement," especially for that latter business.

units.source_text: 就是靠这种分文不值的素贡，他的小小的火苗被安全管理了。

en.t: It was by means of this worthless accomplishment that his little flame was kept safely under control.

units.source_text: 他大概在为自己是火苗管理人、是一位对社会毫不懈怠的完美的管火人而自鸣得意吧。

en.t: He was probably congratulating himself on being the keeper of the flame, a perfect fire warden who never neglected his duty to society.
